durable: pi-durable 1.1.0 Harness over file-backed SQLite with requestId resume binding; replay unsafe by default
bridge_client: vendored copy of adapters/pi/bridge-client.mjs: the pinned adapter digest covers its own protocol bytes, so framing and caps stay inside this contract instead of a shared import
request_bound: requests_per_run is the single per-unit spend bound: every provider request passes _budget admission, and a per-run refusal aborts the submission (request_bound)
store_compat_note: Integer session-store format declared by the adapter. Session identity covers it instead of the adapter digest, so launcher changes that keep this value continue the same durable conversation; bump only on a store-incompatible adapter change
